name: Vox Paper
tagline: vox-editorial's paper and red marker: grey paper, ink, a red offset stroke, orange and highlighter — four inks and a paper.

motion.direction: vox-editorial `vox-skill`. "Four inks and a paper is the whole system": paper `stage`, ink `ink`, red marker `ter` as an offset stroke behind cut-outs, orange `goldd`, highlighter `gold`. Archivo Black UPPERCASE headlines and numbers (letter-spacing −1 to −3), Montserrat small caps for `counter`s, Playfair for a masthead `chapterCard`. Entrances spring (damping 18, mass 0.75, stiffness 110) rising from below with a 16-frame opacity ramp; no two elements land on the same frame (stagger 20–30 frames); flat elements rotated 0.4–1.2°; draw-on strokes (`strikeLine`) inOut cubic. Captions 2–4 words in Archivo Black on a soft ink plate. The hook withholds the subject; the last line answers it; counters land on the spoken word. Never open a beat on an empty frame; never add a colour.
